calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their recent three-day move is negative relative to their trailing 20-day realized volatility; all inputs are lagged and observable at the decision date. Cross-sectional Spearman IC is evaluated against forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.048378), 2023-2024 (+0.023214), and 2025-2027 (+0.033582), supporting cross-regime sign stability. The 5-day and 10-day effects decay materially, so admission uses the daily horizon.
